title: HLAhaploTools
description:
HLAhaploTools assigns and estimates extended HLA and MHC haplotypes. In families it phases haplotypes from inheritance; in unrelated people it estimates haplotype frequencies with an expectation-maximisation (EM) algorithm, keeping people who are untyped or half-typed at some loci. It reads laboratory typing reports (MAC, GL strings, GLS, HML, NGSengine), resolves any IPD-IMGT/HLA locus including MICA, MICB and the non-classical genes, and is compatible with Hapl-o-Mat.

This is a release candidate. Research use only: not validated for clinical use.
